title: Early pay-in of funds allocation (NSE Clearing, CEPF)
purpose: Early pay-in of funds (EPIF) allocated to each client and security against the allocation requested: the sale obligation that needs no margin because the buyer's funds were paid in early.
linked: Loaded as NSE Clearing's early pay-in of funds allocation per client and security (Clearing data); an allocation short of what was requested raises a work item
source: NSE Clearing circular NCL/CMPT/69520 (0230/2025) of 6 Aug 2025, modifying consolidated circular 011/2024: file <member>_CEPFYYYYMMDD.csv.gz in /cmftp/<MEMCD>/CEP/Dnld; control record 10,DDMMYYYY,Member Code,Number of Records; detail record 20, Settlement Type, Settlement Number, TM Code, Client Code, Symbol, Series, Allocation Requested, Amount Allocated
